subject.summary: The Faisal Mosque in Islamabad: the national mosque of Pakistan, an eight-sided concrete shell shaped like a Bedouin tent and four 90 m minarets, with a walled courtyard and porticoes before the prayer hall. Documented dimensions where a source gives them; the shell's curve, the portico bays and the site are a reconstruction.

sources.title: The user's request
sources.ref: A construct and a 9:16 film of Faisal Masjid, Islamabad.

sources.title: Wikipedia
sources.ref: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faisal_Mosque - national mosque, Vedat Dalokay, 1976-1986, first prayer 18 June 1988, eight-sided tent-shaped shell with no dome, four 90 m minarets, 10,000 in the hall, 300,000 total, 130,000 m2, entrance from the east with a courtyard and porticoes, four concrete girders.
